answer: The quill I would price into every new account is Invested farrier registration with farriers council attestation: a registration the council renews after forge audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a registration the council renews after forge audits stays private; the summit is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The garden is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
